description: Manage customer conversations, contacts and WhatsApp campaigns in Intelli.

interface.longDescription: Intelli helps customer support, sales and marketing teams manage customer engagement from ChatGPT and Codex. Connect your Intelli account to review and summarize customer conversations, manage contacts and tags, prepare WhatsApp template campaigns, and inspect campaign delivery and read statistics. You can also manage assistant instructions and knowledge, draft and validate chatbot flows, configure supported channels and website widgets, and manage Intelli store products and storefronts. Confirm changes and outgoing messages before they are carried out. Access follows the organizations and permissions available to your connected Intelli account.
defaultPrompt: Show me the delivery results for my latest campaign.
Show me the VIP contacts in my Intelli workspace.

positive.description: Use a dedicated test account with an accessible sample organization. Compare returned organizations and roles with that account's configured memberships.
positive.prompt: Which Intelli organizations can I access, and what is my role in each?
positive.expected_behavior: List only organizations and roles returned by whoami. Do not invent memberships or change any data.

positive.description: In the selected sample organization, seed contacts with and without a VIP tag. If multiple organizations exist, select the intended one before listing contacts.
positive.prompt: Show me the VIP contacts in my Intelli workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the organization_id returned by whoami and tag='VIP'. Report only returned contacts, respect pagination, and explain that the tag filter can match partial names. Send no messages.

positive.description: Use a sample organization with a connected WhatsApp number and templates in known approval states. Select the sender if multiple numbers exist.
positive.prompt: Which WhatsApp templates are approved for my business number?
positive.expected_behavior: Discover the sender and use its phone_number with the selected organization_id. Identify APPROVED templates from returned statuses; report language and available structure without claiming pending or rejected templates are ready. Do not send a template.

positive.description: Use a sample organization with at least one campaign and delivery statistics. Select a specific campaign from the returned list before requesting statistics.
positive.prompt: Show me the delivery and read results for my latest WhatsApp campaign.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected organization_id and the returned whatsapp_campaign_id as campaign_id. Establish the latest campaign from returned dates, or clarify if ordering cannot be determined. Report actual delivery and read data; queued or sent counts do not prove delivery. Do not run, cancel, or delete a campaign.

positive.description: Use a sample organization with an assistant whose saved name and full prompt are known. Select the assistant if there are multiple matches.
positive.prompt: Show me my support assistant's current instructions before I decide what to change.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the organization_id from whoami and external assistant_id from list_assistants, not a numeric id. Show the saved name and full prompt from get_assistant. Do not update the assistant.

negative.description: Text-only chat boundary. Explain that image replies must be sent through the Intelli inbox. Do not invoke send_chat_message or another send tool as an image-send workaround.
negative.prompt: Send a photo reply to this customer through Intelli.

negative.description: Knowledge website-crawl boundary. Explain that this MCP connection cannot crawl a website into an assistant and suggest a supported document upload. Do not invoke upload_assistant_knowledge with a website URL as though crawling succeeded.
negative.prompt: Crawl my entire website and add every page to my Intelli assistant's knowledge.

negative.description: Meta catalogue boundary. Explain that these tools manage Intelli store products and cannot edit Meta catalogue products. Do not invoke update_store_product or another mutation to claim a Meta catalogue change.
negative.prompt: Change the price of this product in my Meta catalogue using Intelli.

review.commerce_description: The plugin supports managing products, catalogues and storefronts in the Intelli store. It is free for all Intelli customers and users. All billing and payments take place in the Intelli app, including Intelli subscriptions and applicable usage charges. The plugin does not process checkout or collect payment details.

publication.release_notes: Connect Intelli to review customer conversations, manage contacts, prepare WhatsApp campaigns and inspect campaign results. This release includes clarified listing information and a demonstration video for review.
